video_cube_orbit — VIDEOCUBE render op

• Data kinds: video → rgbvideo

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.video_cube_orbit(video, n_frames: 'int' = 36, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, size: 'int' = 256, sigma: 'float' = 1.0, alpha_gain: 'float' = 1.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.02, color: 'str' = 'time', mode: 'str' = 'motion', depth_samples: 'int | None' = None, floor: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'np.ndarray' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import videocube; videocube.video_cube_orbit(video, n_frames: 'int' = 36, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, size: 'int' = 256, sigma: 'float' = 1.0, alpha_gain: 'float' = 1.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.02, color: 'str' = 'time', mode: 'str' = 'motion', depth_samples: 'int | None' = None, floor: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'np.ndarray', registry से लेना हो तो opsvideocube.get("video_cube_orbit"))

उपयोग

cube को घुमाने वाला रंगीन video (n_frames, size, size, 3) float [0, 1] (rgbvideo)।

video_spacetime_cube(mode) को opacity बनाकर ("motion" = video की trajectories, "dark" / "bright" = z stack की membrane या cells), color="time" पर पहले axis (समय / depth) के रंग से, "intensity" पर brightness से रंगता है, और yaw को yaw_start से yaw_span degrees तक बराबर हिस्सों में घुमाता है (pitch fixed)। exhibits और Studio का exit। video_write_gif से सीधे GIF बनाया जा सकता है।

>>> frames = video_cube_orbit(clip, n_frames=24, size=200)

>>> video_write_gif(frames, "cube.gif", fps=10)
